name: Hostinger
tagline: Affordable web hosting with a custom, beginner-friendly dashboard
description: Hostinger is a budget-friendly web hosting provider known for its custom hPanel dashboard, long-term promotional pricing, and beginner-friendly setup.
about: Hostinger offers shared, cloud and VPS hosting plans, built around its own hPanel control panel rather than the industry-standard cPanel — a cleaner, simpler interface aimed at beginners.

Shared hosting comes in three tiers: Premium (3 websites, 20GB SSD storage), Unlimited (unlimited websites, 50GB NVMe storage), and Cloud Startup (unlimited websites, 100GB NVMe storage). All three include a free domain for the first year, free SSL, a CDN and ecommerce capability.

Introductory pricing on the lowest 48-month term runs $2.99/month (Premium), $3.99/month (Unlimited) or $7.99/month (Cloud Startup) — but renews at $10.99, $16.99 and $25.99 per month respectively once the initial term ends. Factor the renewal rate into the real long-term cost before committing to the longest term for the lowest headline price.
policies: Hostinger backs its hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

faqs.a: No — Hostinger built its own control panel called hPanel instead of the industry-standard cPanel. It's generally considered cleaner and easier for beginners, though it has a different learning curve if you're used to cPanel.

faqs.q: Is Hostinger's promotional price the price I'll always pay?
faqs.a: No. Hostinger's lowest advertised prices require a long upfront term (often 24-48 months) and the plan renews at a higher rate afterward — check the renewal price before committing, not just the introductory offer.
